page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred title lines in large capitals across the middle of the page. A faint ghosted title of another work shows through at the top (show-through, not transcribed). No running text, no margin notes.
page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side appears at the top of the page (large ghosted letters) and is not transcribed. Faint ink stains and smudges lie over the lower half. The title is set in roman capitals of several sizes, with the word IN and AD in small spaced capitals. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
